I can't set this up. I don't have a way to schedule recurring posts, so nothing will go out at 17:30 on weekdays unless someone runs it by hand.

Two things to know if you want to try another route:

- Today is Saturday, October 24, so "starting today" would mean the first weekday post is Monday, October 26 at 17:30.
- To get a digest of #strategic-pod's new messages, ask me in this channel and I'll post the "Pod end of day" summary then. I can also do it at the end of each day if you remind me, though that's manual rather than automatic.

If you need it automated, your workspace admin will need to set up a scheduled job.
